terraform {
  required_providers {
    aws = {
      source  = "hashicorp/aws"
      version = "~> 5.0"
    }
  }
}

provider "aws" {
  region = "us-east-1"
}

resource "aws_iam_user" "tj" {
  name = "TJ"
}

resource "aws_iam_policy" "glacier_efs_ec2" {
  name = "GlacierEFSEC2"

  policy = jsonencode({
    Version = "2012-10-17"
    Statement = [
      {
        Sid    = "EC2Management"
        Effect = "Allow"
        Action = [
          "ec2:Describe*",
          "ec2:StartInstances",
          "ec2:StopInstances",
          "ec2:RebootInstances",
          "ec2:RunInstances",
          "ec2:TerminateInstances",
          "ec2:CreateTags",
          "ec2:DeleteTags",
          "ec2:CreateSecurityGroup",
          "ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup",
          "ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress",
          "ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupEgress",
          "ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress",
          "ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupEgress",
          "ec2:CreateKeyPair",
          "ec2:DeleteKeyPair",
          "ec2:CreateSnapshot",
          "ec2:DeleteSnapshot",
          "ec2:CreateImage",
          "ec2:DeregisterImage",
          "ec2:CreateVolume",
          "ec2:DeleteVolume",
          "ec2:AttachVolume",
          "ec2:DetachVolume",
          "ec2:ModifyInstanceAttribute",
          "ec2:GetConsoleOutput",
          "ec2:GetPasswordData"
        ]
        Resource = "*"
      },
      {
        Sid    = "EFSClientMount"
        Effect = "Allow"
        Action = [
          "elasticfilesystem:ClientMount",
          "elasticfilesystem:ClientWrite",
          "elasticfilesystem:ClientRootAccess",
          "elasticfilesystem:DescribeMountTargets",
          "elasticfilesystem:DescribeFileSystems"
        ]
        Resource = "*"
      },
      {
        Sid    = "GlacierVaultAccess"
        Effect = "Allow"
        Action = [
          "glacier:CreateVault",
          "glacier:DeleteVault",
          "glacier:DescribeVault",
          "glacier:ListVaults",
          "glacier:UploadArchive",
          "glacier:DownloadArchive",
          "glacier:DeleteArchive",
          "glacier:InitiateJob",
          "glacier:DescribeJob",
          "glacier:ListJobs",
          "glacier:SetVaultNotifications",
          "glacier:GetVaultNotifications",
          "glacier:DeleteVaultNotifications",
          "glacier:SetVaultAccessPolicy",
          "glacier:GetVaultAccessPolicy",
          "glacier:DeleteVaultAccessPolicy",
          "glacier:ListTagsForVault",
          "glacier:AddTagsToVault",
          "glacier:RemoveTagsFromVault",
          "glacier:InitiateMultipartUpload",
          "glacier:UploadMultipartPart",
          "glacier:CompleteMultipartUpload",
          "glacier:AbortMultipartUpload",
          "glacier:ListMultipartUploads",
          "glacier:ListParts"
        ]
        Resource = "*"
      }
    ]
  })
}

resource "aws_iam_user_policy_attachment" "tj_glacier_efs_ec2" {
  user       = aws_iam_user.tj.name
  policy_arn = aws_iam_policy.glacier_efs_ec2.arn
}

output "iam_user_name" {
  value = aws_iam_user.tj.name
}

output "policy_arn" {
  value = aws_iam_policy.glacier_efs_ec2.arn
}

provider "aws" {
  region = "us-east-1"
}

variable "rolename" {
  description = "Name of the IAM role for the third-party security auditing platform"
  type        = string
  default     = "WizAccess-Role"
}

variable "remote-arn" {
  description = "ARN of the external AWS principal allowed to assume the role"
  type        = string
  default     = "arn:aws:iam::830522659852:role/prod-us43-AssumeRoleDelegator"
}

variable "external-id" {
  description = "External ID required for cross-account assume role"
  type        = string
  default     = "fc959d31-537c-4108-8b87-9af9e0c9b8d2"
}

data "aws_iam_policy_document" "assume_role" {
  statement {
    actions = ["sts:AssumeRole"]

    principals {
      type        = "AWS"
      identifiers = [var.remote-arn]
    }

    condition {
      test     = "StringEquals"
      variable = "sts:ExternalId"
      values   = [var.external-id]
    }
  }
}

resource "aws_iam_role" "wiz_access_role" {
  name               = var.rolename

# Description

This Terraform template deploys a self-contained VPC network and EC2 inventory node cluster:

- **Variables**: cluster prefix (5–8 chars, default `bench`), VPC CIDR (`172.16.0.0/16`), SSH key pair name/public key, public/private subnet maps with AZ + CIDR mask, dynamic ingress CIDR rules, and an inventory node list (AMI, instance type, root volume, optional EIP, secondary EBS volumes with device/mount point).
- **Networking**: VPC with DNS support/hostnames, Internet Gateway, dynamically calculated subnet CIDRs via `cidrsubnet`, public route table (0.0.0.0/0 → IGW), per-subnet Elastic IPs + NAT Gateways, and private route tables routing 0.0.0.0/0 → NAT.
- **Security**: default SG with self-referencing all-traffic ingress, egress restricted to VPC CIDR, plus dynamic ingress CIDR rules.
- **Compute**: SSH key pair, latest AMI data source, EBS-optimized instances placed in subnets by index, optional Elastic IPs, and attached secondary EBS volumes.

  required_providers {
    aws = {

      version = "~> 5.0"
    }
  }

  region = "us-east-1"
}

  description = "Prefix for resource names (5-8 characters)"
  type        = string
  default     = "bench"
